summary: Iter 18 backend regression + new /api/system/* endpoint testing complete. Backend unit tests: 10/10 pass (backend_iter18_test.py — installer detection, semver parsing, GitHub asset picker for win/darwin, version endpoint field presence). Live integration tests: 10/10 pass (backend_iter18_live_test.py) via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: (a) GET /api/system/version (requires auth) returns is_installer_build=false, is_git_repo=true, version='0.0.0-dev', github_repo='sb-witzy/Narrative-2', plus commit/branch/platform. (b) POST /api/system/check-updates in dev mode returns HTTP 502 with detail (git remote missing) — does NOT crash to 500. (c) POST /api/system/update on Linux returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Self-update in git mode is only supported on Windows. Run `./windows/update.bat` manually.' (d) Both endpoints correctly return 401 unauthenticated. (e) Regression: /api/auth/login+/me, /api/history, /api/appeals/patterns, /api/generate (D2740 with tags stripped), /api/appeals (with denial_reason), PATCH /api/appeals/{id} outcome — all still 200. (f) YAML validation: both .github/workflows/build-installer.yml and build-installer-mac.yml parse cleanly via PyYAML safe_load. No backend regressions detected from the installer/updater refactor.

minor.issue: Requires authentication (returns 401 anonymously). Not a bug per se, but if the Settings.jsx page is intended to show version on a public/login screen or before auth, this would block it. Confirm intent — current behavior matches Depends(get_current_user).

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether /api/system/version should be public — currently gated behind get_current_user. If Settings.jsx only calls it post-login this is fine.
server.py is now ~1192 lines (up from 882 last iter). The 700-line split threshold is well exceeded; splitting into routers/ modules is overdue but non-blocking.

The Windows installer NSSM-via-Chocolatey change and Pascal-script activation key generation cannot be exercised in this container — must be verified by pushing to GitHub Actions windows-latest runner (out of scope per user request).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_is_installer_build()` correctly requires BOTH (a) absence of .git AND (b) a non-dev VERSION file value. This prevents accidental installer-mode detection in dev environments. Good defensive logic.

server.py `_parse_semver()` strips 'v' prefix and pre-release suffix — reasonable simplification, but note that '1.0.0-rc2' and '1.0.0-rc1' compare equal. If prerelease ordering ever matters, packaging.version.Version would be a safer choice.

server.py `_github_latest_release()` selects asset by sys.platform ('win32' -> .exe, 'darwin' -> .pkg). No fallback if neither found — will raise KeyError on 'asset_url'. Consider a graceful 502/'no compatible asset' path.
server.py `system_update` returns 400 with clear cross-platform guidance. Good UX.

server.py `system_check_updates` in dev/git mode returns 502 when `git ls-remote` fails; this is the correct signal (upstream unreachable) and matches spec. Message includes stderr — verify no sensitive info (e.g., internal tokens) is echoed in the detail; current path uses `_git()` which returns plain rc/stdout so likely safe.
YAML: both build-installer.yml and build-installer-mac.yml parse valid. The Chocolatey NSSM step change is syntactically correct — actual runtime verification requires GitHub Actions runner.

server.py total ~1192 lines — split threshold (700) exceeded by a wide margin. Recommend splitting /api/system/* into routers/system.py, /api/appeals/* into routers/appeals.py on the next iteration to improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Generated 3 TEST_iter18 narratives (D2740, D2950) and 1 appeal (outcome=pending) under admin user. No data cleanup because appeals PATCH sets outcome back to pending; narratives remain in admin history but tagged with TEST_iter18 in clinical_findings.

In dev: is_installer_build=false, is_git_repo=true, version='0.0.0-dev'. /api/system/check-updates -> 502 in dev mode (no git remote). /api/system/update -> 400 on Linux. /api/appeals now REQUIRES denial_reason field (422 without it). YAML workflow changes (Chocolatey NSSM install) can only be verified by pushing to GitHub Actions windows-latest — not testable in this container. server.py is 1192 lines; split into routers is recommended but not blocking.
